name: MOSS-1
author: Theo Wecker
tagline: lofi, nature sounds and ambient loops for the FM-1
description: Ambient firmware with three modes. LOFI plays electric piano over a slow beat with tape wobble and crackle. SCAPES plays nature sounds (forest, rain, shore, night, storm, campfire, creek) with a quiet pad. DRIFT plays pads and bells on loops of different lengths. Play the keys and the music follows you. A looper with eight layers and eight saved slots keeps what you like. A chords screen picks chords of the key, builds a progression of any chords or plays whole chords live. Thirteen spaces, six drum kits, a bass, a sleep timer and pixel art for every scene.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
